events.evidence: American troops complete their withdrawal from Iraq, ending their 23-year presence in the country that started with the 2003 U.S. invasion
Unknown gunmen open fire against a bus carrying employees returning home from work in Homs, Syria, killing seven people and wounding four more
Romania's parliament rejects prime minister-designate Siegfried Mureșan's proposed government, receiving 182 of the 233 votes required for approval, prolonging the political crisis

label.note: Iraq withdrawal, Syria attack and Romanian government rejection dominate; mixed regional signals.
